acceptance.title: Basic gates
acceptance.requirement: Create two switch inputs and an AND gate; verify all four combinations.
observed: Primitive and NAND-derived gate assertions pass.
Browser palette construction, typed wiring and the four-row truth table pass in Chromium, Firefox and WebKit.

acceptance.title: NAND composition
acceptance.requirement: Implement XOR with NAND logic, verify the full table and inspect its real internal circuit.
observed: Four-NAND XOR is executed exhaustively.
Saved NAND-XOR is instantiated twice and evaluated through the common simulator.
The inspector reads the actual instance path.
All three browser engines assert XOR outputs 0,1,1,0, then inspect exactly four NAND components and no XOR component inside the module.

acceptance.title: Custom chip
acceptance.requirement: Save an executable circuit as a typed reusable chip and verify another circuit uses its internal logic.
observed: NAND-XOR extraction, independent instances, shared fan-out ports and distinct bus/carry ports pass.
Browser custom-chip save, reuse and live internal inspection pass in three engines.

acceptance.title: Sequential logic
acceptance.requirement: Changing register data while paused must preserve stored output until the enabled clock edge.
observed: Pre-edge and atomic state tests pass.
The browser register holds 42 during paused and disabled edits, then updates to 99 at an enabled edge.
Nested inspection preserves per-instance sequential state.

acceptance.title: Arithmetic
acceptance.requirement: Verify eight-bit adder and subtractor including carry, borrow and modular wraparound.
observed: 131072 ADDER vectors and 131072 SUBTRACTOR vectors cover every byte pair and both carry/borrow inputs.
65536 comparator pairs pass.
CPU ADD and SUB each cover all 65536 byte pairs with ISA carry/no-borrow semantics.

acceptance.title: CPU execution
acceptance.requirement: Run the 3 + 4 assembly program on the actual circuit CPU and observe OUT equal to 7.
observed: Direct generic Simulator execution, without CpuMachine, yields A=7, OUT=7, PC=5, HALTED=1 and RAM[240]=3.
Changing the real ALU B-input wire to zero changes OUT to 4.
The browser 3 + 4 scenario passes in all three engines.

acceptance.title: CPU branching
acceptance.requirement: Execute loops and verify PC changes and conditional branches use registered flags.
observed: 12288 architectural transitions from 96 deterministic programs match the test-only reference.
All 256 opcode bytes and reserved fault behavior are tested.
The browser summation loop produces 55 in all three engines.

acceptance.title: Debugging
acceptance.requirement: Stop before a breakpoint and step backward to restore the preceding complete machine state.
observed: Breakpoints, one-shot resume, looping stops, RAM watchpoints, backward/forward snapshots and future truncation pass.
The browser stops at PC=4 before OUT and restores the pre-OUT machine after rewind.
The final three-engine browser run verifies watchpoint stops and synchronous cancellation before manual pause, snapshot restoration, reset, source editing and reassembly using a running 100 Hz loop.

acceptance.title: Waveforms
acceptance.requirement: Record actual clock, register and control pin values while executing multiple instructions.
observed: Real source-clock observations alternate rising=1 and falling=0.
Exported captures include actual OUT and other probe values.
Sustained execution retains at most 1024 waveform samples.

acceptance.title: Academy
acceptance.requirement: Complete an interactive wiring challenge using simulated output-based verification.
observed: Candidate circuits are executed with complete small-input tables, larger boundary/sample vectors and sequential hold/update sequences.
An unclocked register passthrough and an always-enabled faulty register are rejected.
Direct browser pin wiring earns persisted progress in all three engines.
Verification banners are associated with the exact checked solution so source edits and reset cannot display obsolete success.
The strengthened browser test restores the starter, confirms the success banner disappears and outputs become unavailable, then confirms earned progress still survives reload.

acceptance.title: Persistence
acceptance.requirement: Save, reload, export and import a project while preserving topology and executable behavior.
observed: Real IndexedDB and JSON browser round-trips preserve source, topology and simulated AND behavior.
A width-error editing draft survives reload beside a healthy project.
Malformed raw records are isolated and retained, with unreadable counts exposed.
Current-project duplication uses the latest project reference; deletion failures show a notice.
The integrated 218-test run includes a missing-crypto.randomUUID regression for ordinary HTTP previews; manual preview startup and CPU execution passed afterward.
A compressed share URL opened in a fresh browser context restores source, topology and executable behavior; Copy link reports success or manual-copy guidance while preserving the readable URL.

acceptance.title: Localization
acceptance.requirement: Switch English and Turkish and observe localized major interfaces and lessons.
observed: Localized Academy feedback assertions pass.
Turkish shell/editor controls, document language, documentation navigation and language persistence pass in three browser engines.
The strengthened browser path observes Turkish CPU source/load/run controls, memory labels and ALU explanation, and runs the actual addition program to OUT=7.
The Turkish lesson foundation and hint are checked; direct pin wiring earns localized successful behavioral verification.
The final three-engine workflow explicitly switches back to English and verifies the restored English interface.

acceptance.title: Deployment
acceptance.requirement: Operate at the user-corrected /NandForge/ base and verify the GitHub Pages workflow and public site.
observed: The production preview operates under /NandForge/ in all three tested browser engines.
Pages repository settings were read and already use GitHub Actions.
The workflow gates publication on typecheck, lint, tests, build and three-engine browser execution.
Pages source is already GitHub Actions; no owner setting change is required.
Final-source workflow 39064679103 completed successfully: validation job 117489719266 passed 14/14 steps and Pages publication job 117490439008 passed 4/4 steps.
The exact public URL https://berkopan.github.io/NandForge/ loaded and navigated to #/lab and #/cpu.
Public Home and the real two-NAND Circuit Lab graph produced the complete correct AND truth table, with zero circuit diagnostics.
The public CPU executed the mandatory six-word program to A=7, OUT=7, PC=5 HOLD and Halted at cycle 6; the waveform panel held 13 actual samples.
A public browser console query returned no warnings or errors (limit 20).
A hard reload on public #/cpu preserved the six-instruction source, reopened Ready, and executed successfully again to Halted with PC HOLD and output 0x07; console inspection remained empty.

acceptance.title: Verification
acceptance.requirement: Run and accurately report the actual tests, type checker, linter and production build.
observed: Integrated npm test passed 218 tests in 17 files, with reported duration 1.72 seconds; this includes the HTTP identifier regression.
Global npm run typecheck and npm run lint passed.
The final production build and three-engine browser suite passed: 60 executions, 20 per engine, 73.60569 seconds, zero unexpected, flaky or skipped tests.
The benchmark emitted measured results after deterministic correctness checks.

implementationBoundaries: Two-valued unsigned 1–16-bit synchronous simulation with explicit source clocks.
Composite combinational logic and CPU control execute actual NAND-derived graphs.
DFF, RAM, ROM, clocks, external inputs and wiring are declared idealized boundaries.
Compiled full-pass evaluation with dirty-state skipping; no worker, per-net event queue or physical timing claim.
Project topology, chip definitions and assembly source persist; CPU/register/probe/breakpoint/history session state is transient across route unmount and reload.
Internal storage admits safe typed semantic-error drafts while keeping structural, schema, prototype, reference, interface, recursion and resource validation.
